conclusions: First damping preceded RViz goal receipt by 0.633 seconds.
RViz goal was accepted by policy after damping; no subsequent ACP entry event exists.
First withdrawal recovered about 26 ms later; periodic relay trace missed its exact reason.
DLIO registration rejection happened later and is not the initiating damping event.
view_remote.sh runs RViz on G1 over X11 with software GL. CPU contention is a hypothesis, not proven root cause.
changes: Reduce RViz rendering to 10 Hz and nice 10; cap Mesa/OpenMP/BLAS workers at one.
Record odometry withdrawal reason immediately, bypassing 200 ms trace sampling on error transitions.
Clarify RViz relay goal-written message does not prove policy acceptance.
limitations: No new raw sensor bag captured in this experiment; cannot reproduce native rejection offline from these logs alone.
Physical efficacy of resource mitigation is unverified; guard thresholds are unchanged.
